cases.question: What did the October 2025 digest report about Miami-Dade sales in September 2025?

citations.title: Miami-Dade Real Estate Registers Best Sales Month of the Year; Affordable and $1M & Up Condo Transactions Surge
citations.publisher: MIAMI Association of Realtors® (via PR Newswire)

citations.title: South Florida Residential Sales Surge in September 2025
Lower mortgage rates extend housing momentum into fall

response.review_notice: Archive preview: source summaries await verification.
response.answer: The archived digest reports that Miami-Dade experienced its strongest sales month of 2025 in September, with total home sales increasing by 4.6% year-over-year [1]. This growth was supported by a 5% rise in total residential sales volume for the county [2]. Market activity was notably driven by surges in both affordable condo transactions (≤$250K), which rose 30%, and luxury condo sales (≥$1M), which increased by 20% [1]. These results are attributed to declining mortgage rates, which helped unlock pent-up buyer demand [1]. Regarding pricing, median values for single-family homes rose 1.8% year-over-year to $665,000, while condo prices remained unchanged at $420,000 [1]. Additionally, Miami was identified as one of the nation's strongest buyer's markets due to high inventory levels [5].

cases.question: ¿Qué decían las noticias de septiembre de 2025 sobre los condominios antiguos frente a la construcción nueva?

response.answer: El resumen archivado indica que, en septiembre de 2025, los condominios antiguos en Miami-Dade se vendían más rápido que las unidades de nueva construcción debido a una crisis de asequibilidad [1]. En julio de 2025, los condominios de 30 años o más se vendían en una mediana de 62 días, frente a los 79 días de las unidades nuevas [1]. Los compradores prefieren estas opciones por su menor precio, a menudo inferior a la mitad del costo de una construcción nueva [1]. Además, la ley "Condo 3.0" ha aumentado la confianza en la viabilidad de edificios antiguos [1]. Mientras tanto, el mercado de pre-construcción ha experimentado una desaceleración, llevando a los desarrolladores a buscar compradores internacionales [3]. En West Palm Beach, aunque existe un auge de construcción, las ventas avanzan a un ritmo más paciente y enfocado en usuarios finales [2].

cases.question: What did May 2025 coverage say about searches for Miami property from China?

citations.title: China leads countries searching for Miami real estate

response.review_notice: Archive preview: source summaries await verification.
response.answer: The archived digest reports that mainland China led all countries in searches for Miami real estate during April 2025, accounting for 13% of total search volume [1]. This surge is attributed to Beijing's relaxed outbound-investment rules and a weak yuan, which has encouraged capital flight into dollar-denominated assets [1]. However, the digest notes that visa backlogs remain a significant obstacle to converting these searches into completed sales [1].
